description: Defines the `PubSubSubscriptionState` class used for managing subscription state in Orleans streaming pub/sub system, including serialization details, state management, and equality checks.

classes.name: PubSubSubscriptionState
classes.description: Represents the state of a Pub/Sub subscription, including its identifier, stream ID, consumer, filter data, and current state.

methods.name: PubSubSubscriptionState
methods.description: Constructor initializing subscription with given ID, stream ID, and consumer.

methods.name: AddFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter data for the subscription.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the subscription ID.

methods.name: Fault
methods.description: Sets the subscription state to Faulted.
